definitions.gloss: visceral fat; fat around internal organs
definitions.explanation: fat that accumulates around internal organs in the abdominal cavity, as opposed to subcutaneous fat under the skin

examples.japanese: {内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}を{減|へ}らす。
{内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}が{多|おお}いとメタボになりやすい。
examples.english: Having a lot of visceral fat makes you prone to metabolic syndrome.

examples.japanese: {有酸素運動|ゆうさんそうんどう}は{内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}を{燃焼|ねんしょう}させるのに{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: Aerobic exercise is effective for burning visceral fat.

notes:
HEALTH TERM:
{内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう} is considered more dangerous to health than {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう} (subcutaneous fat).

HEALTH RISKS:
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} - diabetes
- {高血圧|こうけつあつ} - high blood pressure
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか} - arteriosclerosis
- {心臓病|しんぞうびょう} - heart disease

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう} - visceral fat (around organs)
- {皮下脂肪|ひかしぼう} - subcutaneous fat (under skin)

METABOLIC SYNDROME:
{内臓脂肪|ないぞうしぼう}{型|がた}{肥満|ひまん} (visceral fat obesity) is a key criterion for メタボリックシンドローム.

REDUCTION METHODS:
- {有酸素運動|ゆうさんそうんどう} - aerobic exercise
- {食事制限|しょくじせいげん} - dietary restriction
- {糖質|とうしつ}カット - reducing carbohydrates

MEASUREMENT:
- {腹囲|ふくい} - waist circumference
- CTスキャン - CT scan (for accurate measurement)
